resolved_findings.area: Native bootstrap ACL contamination of fresh baseline
resolved_findings.status: corrected source re-read; native default-grant roundtrip and final forward chain verified
resolved_findings.finding: A normal native Supabase public schema grants future postgres-created functions directly to anon/authenticated/service_role. Dumped service-only function ACLs only REVOKE PUBLIC, so applying under those defaults can retain unintentional direct client grants. Existing native reset dropped/recreatedpublic, removing defaults and hiding the projection difference. R2 presign/current-release-key functions rely on ACL rather than in-body role checks.
evidence: database/roundtrip-result.json: native defaults restored before apply; exact definitions/grants/policies equality; 769 functions, 212 tables including private, 5136 relation capabilities
database/final-fresh-apply.json: exact current baseline SHA-256 and all 11 forward migration hashes; all 12 applications exit 0
database/canonical-capability-denials.json: all 14 committed anonymous staff/money denial signatures and 6 R2 presign service-only checks pass
database/critical-smokes/receipt.json: final 16 critical native SQL smokes pass with no migration-source changes during run
resolved_findings.qualification: Local native source-contract acceptance only; no hosted deployment, real Vault secret access or production provider/credential acceptance was attempted.
resolved_findings.correction: Baseline header clears native direct per-role table/sequence/function defaults before CREATEs and preserves normal source PUBLIC function defaults. Curated source reconstruction uses committed simulation bootstrap semantics. New native roundtrip explicitly restores bootstrap grants before apply and compares actual role capabilities, policies and function definitions.

resolved_findings.area: Delivery cash cached retry ownership race
resolved_findings.status: corrected source re-read; native lock/wait and ownership-denial proof passed
resolved_findings.finding: The new outer ownership check could race with a peer collection committing before the retained core cached-result SELECT, which returned before its original ownership checks.
resolved_findings.correction: Reject NULL request IDs and acquire a namespaced per-request transaction advisory lock before both ownership check and retained core call. Only the owning driver/job can receive a cached result.
evidence: supabase/tests/retained_workflow_posting_smoke.sql: actual own retry, peer/wrong-job/null denial and unchanged counts
